hooks.name: tests-on-lib-save
hooks.description: Rerun the statistics and data-layer tests whenever src/lib changes

action.prompt: A file under src/lib/ was just saved. Run `npm test`. If any test fails, find the cause in the code that changed and fix the code. Do not loosen a fast-check property, a tolerance or a golden value to make a test pass; if a property itself is wrong, say why before changing it. The existing estimators in src/lib/stats.ts (kaplanMeier, aalenJohansen, wilson, naiveMedian, logRank, benjaminiHochberg) must not change behaviour.
